criteria.text: Every path that can throw/reject MacOfflineError consumes it through offline state handling rather than allowing an unhandled rejection.

criteria.text: Investigate asymmetric phone transcript latency and fix only if the cause is clearly in scope and low risk.
criteria.reason: The native async generator did not start its SSE fetch until five initial reads completed; stream consumption now starts immediately and those reads settle in the background. Device timing remains a smoke target.

criteria.text: From a cold app start over a representative remote gateway, first transcript open completes within the documented budget on the first user-visible attempt (no double 15s timeout).

criteria.text: Exact-session pinning preserved during any background warmup/discovery.
criteria.reason: The passing contract asserts prewarm calls only /mobile-gateway/health and never a session route.

criteria.text: Transparent retry remains inside a larger first-open budget, and relay warmup failures are classified as transient 504 responses rather than hard 502 responses.
